source_message.text: Also, I have used a feature of enrichment in <http://Apollo.io|Apollo.io> for the contacts having no email addresses. There were 50 contacts and out of 50, <http://apollo.io|apollo.io> could find 11 emails and they were added automatically in Hubspot as there is a integration. For the remaining 39 contacts having no email addresses, I exported the list and uploaded it in Hubspot.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports that the 39 contacts remaining without email addresses were exported from Apollo and uploaded into HubSpot.
